description: Round 1. Cross-fitted (5 folds by source document) multi-head student: gte-modernbert-base truncated to its first 16 layers, input = summary + article sentences selected by lexical overlap with the summary (lead sentence first), 192 tokens, CLS+mean pooling, plus 17 cheap lexical features over the full article (n-gram novelty, lead coverage, repetition, truncation, ...), 4 heads x 5 levels, trained 6 epochs with soft-label KL on qwen3.7-flash labels of the training-fold eval texts (G-Eval-style rubric, self-consistency of 5 votes: greedy + 3 samples + CoT). Mixed int8 ONNX (GLU down-projections fp32). Fold k model scores fold k texts only. Chosen on dev (204 gold, 14 docs never trained on): deployed int8 fold models dev mean 0.500 (fp32 0.505; selection runs 3 seeds 0.5145). Synthetic summaries (LLM and programmatic) and dev gold in training all lowered dev and were not used.

dev_metrics.metric: group_spearman (per source document), mean of 4 dims, dev = 204 gold / 14 docs (never trained on)
